data_fields.name: board_operator
data_fields.donor_constant: best | set | incr | decr (board default, override per write)

data_fields.name: zero_delta_write
data_fields.donor_constant: no write when score and subscore delta are both 0

data_fields.name: tiebreak_subscore
data_fields.donor_constant: subscore moves with score; better if either field is better

data_fields.name: attempt_top_up
data_fields.donor_constant: count added to the cap while the window is open

data_fields.name: board_max_size
data_fields.donor_constant: max_size; 0 = unlimited; new rows take a slot

best_idea: A single conditional server write per submission that changes the stored value only when it is a real change, counts accepted attempts, and refuses over-cap submissions inside the same transaction so nothing is kept.
decision_why: Keep the no-op filters, the best/set/incr/decr split and the attempt cap with its in-transaction refusal for a server-verified per-period board; reject the Postgres-specific SQL and the silent join-path skip, which must return an explicit error.
acceptance: A server test submits best-of scores 10, 7 and 12 to a daily board and asserts the stored best is 12 and the count is 3; a fourth submission against a cap of 3 is refused with an error and leaves the stored score and count unchanged.
